title: My Weekend at the Market
text:
Hi everyone! This weekend I went to the big market in my town. I wanted to buy fresh fruit and some new shoes. The market was very busy, but the vegetables were cheap and fresh. I bought apples, oranges, and a pair of blue shoes.

After lunch, I sat in a small café and read a book. The coffee was hot and the music was nice. I felt relaxed. Next weekend I want to go back and try the bread from the bakery.

questions.text: Where did the writer go this weekend?
options: To the big market in her town
To a large shopping mall in another city
To the beach with her friends
To a museum near her house

questions.text: What did the writer buy at the market?
options: Apples, oranges, and a pair of blue shoes
A new bag and some bread

questions.text: Why does the writer want to go back to the bakery next weekend?
options: She wants to try the bread there
She wants to buy a new café
She is looking for a lost book
She wants to meet her friends

questions.text: What can we infer about how the writer felt on Saturday afternoon?

calm and not worried or stressed

paragraph_translations: Merhaba herkese! Bu hafta sonu kasabamdaki büyük pazara gittim. Taze meyve ve yeni bir ayakkabı almak istiyordum. Pazar çok kalabalıktı, ama sebzeler ucuz ve tazeydi. Elma, portakal ve bir çift mavi ayakkabı aldım.
Öğle yemeğinden sonra küçük bir kafede oturup bir kitap okudum. Kahve sıcaktı ve müzik güzeldi. Kendimi rahat hissettim. Gelecek hafta fırına geri dönüp oradaki ekmeği denemek istiyorum.
